components.name: Checkbox
components.css: .ds-checkbox { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: #1c1c19; } .ds-checkbox-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-checkbox-box { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid #dec0b7; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #ffffff; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 0.125rem; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-checkbox-input:checked + .ds-checkbox-box { background: #486458; border-color: #486458; } .ds-checkbox-input:focus-visible + .ds-checkbox-box { outline: 2px solid #486458; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-checkbox-input:not(:checked) + .ds-checkbox-box svg { opacity: 0; }

narrative.overview: This design system embodies refined African minimalism—a modern, respectful convergence of Yoruba herbal tradition and contemporary digital commerce. It serves conscious wellness seekers, herbalists, and diaspora communities who want authentic traditional preparations inside a premium, trustworthy interface. The shop operates in Spanish (es-MX) with prices in MXN.
keyCharacteristics: Specimen-archive editorial rhythm with commerce density where checkout demands it.
Tonal depth over floating cards at rest; motion and shadow respond to state.
Token-faithful palette: every UI color resolves to a frontmatter colors.* key.
Spanish UI copy; Latin botanical names preserved; Yoruba product names where culturally accurate.
Operate mode for shop, cart, checkout, account, and admin.

rules.name: The Fired-Clay Restraint Rule
rules.body: primary (#781f00) should cover no more than roughly 10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point; larger warm areas use primary-container (#9a3412).

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce hex values outside the frontmatter colors map. If a new role is needed, extend the Stitch export first, then update prose and Tailwind together.

rules.name: The Specimen Label Rule
rules.body: Technical and table headers use label-sm (10px, weight 700, letter-spacing 0.08em) in uppercase Spanish where appropriate (e.g. LOTE, DOSIS).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only as a response to hover, elevation, or focus—not as decoration.

dos: Do map every UI color to a frontmatter colors.* token and keep Tailwind/shadcn variables in sync with this file.
Do write all shipped UI copy in Spanish (es-MX); show Latin botanical names and Yoruba product names where accurate.
Do use @tabler/icons-react for standard icons; use inline SVG for cultural marks.
Do compose screens inside feature folders; keep components/ui limited to shadcn primitives.
Do consult vitalis-conventions and Impeccable for polish, audit, and harden passes before release.
donts: Don't paste ad hoc hex values (including legacy prose colors) that are not in the Stitch frontmatter.
Don't ship Lucide icons in production UI; replace shadcn template defaults with Tabler.
Don't add drop shadows on cards at rest; use borders and surface steps first.
Don't use English for customer-facing labels in the shop, checkout, or account flows.
Don't duplicate skills or agent instructions outside .agents/skills/ and root AGENTS.md.
